pack.summary: This week, students are exploring the story 'The Boy Who Cried Wolf' while focusing on soft c and g phonics, three-letter spelling blends, and prefixes. In Religion, the class is learning about the 1st Great Commandment and the first three Commandments, while Math focuses on two-digit addition with and without regrouping.
